sloka: को ऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशो धनुष्मान् हरिलोचनः।युक्ते हयसहस्रेण विशाले स्यन्दने स्थितः ।। ६.७१.१२ ।।
transliteration: ko 'sau parvatasaṅkāśo dhanuṣmān harilocanaḥ।yukte hayasahasreṇa viśāle syandane sthitaḥ ।। 6.71.12 ।।

translations.english: "Who is he, the yelloweyed, resembling a mountain, seated in the broad chariot drawn by a thousand horses?"
